header.title: Access Guard Management
header.tagline: Manage credential bindings, usage limits, and model pricing for API keys.

login.subTitle: Sign in to CLIProxyAPI
login.memoryNote: The key is held in memory only and is lost when the page is closed or refreshed. It is never written to local storage.
login.embeddedFallback: No saved management key was read from the panel ("remember password" may not be checked). Please enter it manually.

footer.text: Powered by the Access Guard plugin

nativeQuotaReset.title: Batch reset quotas
nativeQuotaReset.scope: Only API keys currently in CPA with a binding are listed, including disabled bindings. Unbound keys and keys removed from CPA are excluded.
nativeQuotaReset.warning: Same as the card reset: clears RPM, daily/weekly spend, request counts, tokens and other usage records. This cannot be undone. Limits, credential bindings, model permissions, round robin and enabled status stay unchanged. CPAMP history is not reset.
nativeQuotaReset.empty: There are no API key bindings to reset.
nativeQuotaReset.refreshFailed: Reset completed, but cards could not be refreshed. Close this dialog and refresh the list.
nativeQuotaReset.sessionChanged: The management session changed. Close and reopen this dialog.
nativeQuotaReset.selectionChanged: A selected key or binding was removed, rotated or recreated. No batch reset was performed. Refresh and select again.
nativeQuotaReset.failed: Operation failed. Refresh and try again.

nativeBatch.conflictAuth: An original credential no longer exists
nativeBatch.conflictKey: The original key was removed or rotated
nativeBatch.conflictBinding: The binding was changed by another operation
nativeBatch.conflictIdentity: The binding was replaced with a different identity
nativeBatch.conflictModified: The new binding has edited settings and cannot be removed
nativeBatch.conflictGroup: Legacy credential groups are no longer supported
nativeBatch.conflictRestriction: The original restriction cannot be restored
nativeBatch.restoreExisting: Recreate the previously removed binding with its saved settings.
nativeBatch.title: Batch binding
nativeBatch.scope: Replace credential bindings for the selected keys only. Existing model access, limits, rotation, and enabled state are preserved. Unbound keys get an enabled binding with all models, unlimited usage, and rotation off.
nativeBatch.credentialSearch: Search email, name, plan, or credential ID
nativeBatch.newBinding: New: enabled · all models · unlimited usage · rotation off.
nativeBatch.restoreUnbound: Restoring removes this newly created binding. The key remains in CPA and returns to default routing.
nativeBatch.restoreScope: Restore credential bindings to before the selected operation. Review the differences below; conflicts prevent the entire restore.
nativeBatch.historyHint: The latest 50 batch and restore operations are retained. Restores are recorded too; model access, limits, and rotation do not revert to old settings.
nativeBatch.chooseOperation: Select an operation to see its details and preview a restore.
nativeBatch.nothingToUndo: There is no unreverted batch binding to undo.
nativeBatch.noop: Bindings already match the requested state. No change or history entry is needed.
nativeBatch.incomplete: The credential inventory is incomplete. Refresh it before previewing or applying changes.
nativeBatch.selectionChanged: A selected key or credential changed or was removed. Refresh the inventory and select and preview again.
nativeBatch.conflict: Current state conflicts with the preview or history. The entire operation was blocked. Refresh and preview again.
nativeBatch.sessionChanged: The management session changed. Close this dialog and reopen it for the current CPA.
nativeBatch.historyMissing: The operation is missing or this plugin does not support the batch API. Refresh history and try again.
nativeBatch.historyFailed: History could not be refreshed. Completed changes remain applied; refresh history again.
nativeBatch.requestFailed: The operation failed. Refresh and try again.
nativeBatch.tooLarge: This selection is too large. Reduce it and preview again.
nativeBatch.reviewWarnings: Review bindings being created or removed.

native.mobileNoticeSummary: Disabling a binding leaves the key active with unrestricted credential selection.
native.noticeTitle: For CPA client API keys (access.api-keys) only
native.noticeBody: Restricts an API key to specific credentials. Only redacted previews are shown; the plugin never stores plaintext keys.
native.unbindNotice: After a binding is disabled or deleted, the key remains valid and returns to default/free scheduling. To block access, remove it from CPA's client API keys.
native.loadFailed: The API key list failed to load. This does not mean the host has no keys; restore the Management API and retry.
native.emptyBody: Add keys to CPA's client API keys (access.api-keys) first. After refresh, each key can be limited to specific credentials.
native.copyKeyUnavailable: This key is no longer in CPA, so its full value cannot be copied.
native.credentialsLoadFailed: Credential identities could not be loaded. Bound accounts cannot be displayed, but the key list and binding editor remain available.
native.directReselectionSummary: Exact credential selection is missing — reselect credentials
native.unboundHint: Currently free to use host credentials
native.orphanHint: This binding's key is no longer in CPA's client API keys. The binding is inactive; keep it for rotation or delete it.
native.disableConfirm: Disable API key binding {{id}}? The API key in CPA remains valid and will return to default/free scheduling.
native.deleteConfirm: Delete API key binding {{id}}? The API key in CPA will not be deleted; it remains valid and will return to default/free scheduling.
native.idHint: A stable identifier for this binding; it cannot be changed later.
native.name: Display name (optional)
native.nameFromCPA: This name comes from the CPA key note. Edit it in CPA.
native.nameSyncFailed: Some CPA key notes could not be saved. Refresh to try again.
native.plainKeyHint: Enter a key that already exists in CPA's client API keys. Plaintext is submitted once and cannot be viewed again.
native.selectedKeyHint: This key comes from CPA's current client API keys. Only a redacted preview is rendered; plaintext is never placed in page elements or written to plugin state.
native.keepKeyPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current key
native.rotateKeyHint: Leave blank to keep the current binding. If entered, add the same new key to CPA's client API keys.
native.credentialSearch: Search name, Auth ID, or provider
native.noAIProviderCredentials: No AI provider credentials are configured. Add them under AI Providers in CPA, save, then refresh this list.
native.credentialLoadFailed: Could not load the credential list. Refresh and try again. Saved bindings have been retained.
native.noCredentials: The host returned no exact Auth IDs available for direct binding.
native.credentialHint: This saves an exact Auth ID allow-list, not a round-robin order. New credentials are not added automatically; if every selected credential is unavailable, the request fails instead of returning to free scheduling.
native.allModelsHint: Allow current models and models added in the future.
native.selectedModelsHint: Only checked provider + model pairs can be used.
native.noModelsSelectedWarning: No models are checked. Saving this will prevent the key from calling any model.
native.staleModels: Saved but missing from the current catalog
native.noModels: The host returned no selectable models.
native.modelAccessHint: Select all saves a snapshot of the current catalog; future models are not added automatically. Authorization matches exact provider + model pairs, and thinking suffixes inherit the base model permission. /v1/models may still show the host's global list, but execution is rejected here before scheduling.
native.roundRobinHint: Distribute requests in turn across available bound credentials, allowing multiple credentials to work concurrently. Each request uses one credential at a time.
native.roundRobinScope: Applies only while this binding is enabled. When on, rotate requests without pinning a session to one credential; when off, keep existing priority selection. Other keys retain their settings. Give credentials the same priority to rotate among them.
native.limitsInvalid: Limits must be zero or positive numbers.
native.limitsHint: Empty or 0 = unlimited. USD usage is billed from the model price catalog.
native.resetQuotaConfirm: Reset RPM, daily/weekly usage, and all usage records for API key binding {{id}}? This cannot be undone.

pricingSync.sourceFailed: Last attempt failed; retaining last-known prices

pricing.empty: No pricing data yet. Sync LiteLLM with models.dev fallback, or add a row.
pricing.perMillionHint: Prices are USD per million tokens. Cache write maps to cacheCreation.
pricing.deleteConfirm: Hide pricing for {{id}} from automatic sync?
